csv_scope_of_work: The University of California at San Francisco Medical Center (UCSF Health), Design & Construction is seeking responses to this Request for Qualifications (RFQ) for Architectural/Engineering (A/E) services for elevator modernization projects at various UCSF Health campuses throughout the Bay Area. The services may be used for ongoing efforts at any of UCSF s main campuses such as Parnassus, Mount Zion, and Mission Bay; at smaller owned or leased sites; outpatient clinics in San Francisco and other Bay Area counties; and at affiliated sites such as UCSF Hyde Hospital, UCSF Stanyan Hospital, Benioff Children s Hospital Oakland, and Zuckerberg San Francisco General. Projects may include passenger elevator modernization, freight elevator upgrades, control system replacements, code compliance improvements, accessibility upgrades, machine room improvements, and related infrastructure or building system modifications. As a result of this solicitation, UCSF Health may select up to three (3) or more firms to provide Architectural/Engineering Services as described under Project Scope.
